title: Intrinsic adic fibre comparison for completed rational pullback
statement: Fix finite-field datum D, prime l distinct from its characteristic, a finite extension E of Q_l, separated finite-type geometric bases W,V, a locally closed immersion f:V -> W, and geometric point x:Spec(D.k) -> V. There is a natural isomorphism rationalDerivedPullback(f) followed by sfAdicRationalFiber(x) with sfAdicRationalFiber(x composed with f), on the entire intrinsic raw rational constructible category. Invertibility witnesses are the inherited baseInvertible ones. This statement makes no choices of a classical system or identified heart object. Interfaces: [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-per-adic-base-stages], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-a1-intrinsic-adic-fibre-specification]. Additional interface owners: [def-zl-classical-raw-lisse-realization-data].

proof.text: In the completed coefficient presentation, use the adic-heart pullback-fibre comparison, whose integral map is the composition of the specified completed pullbacks followed by H0, point sections, and localization. Transport it along the constant-section-normalized coefficient equivalence to the intrinsic sf category. The normalized integral pullback comparison identifies its underlying finite tower with that of rationalDerivedPullback. The composition equations identify successive pullback to x then f with pullback to x followed by f.

proof.text: Descend the resulting natural isomorphism and its inverse through raw scalar localization; each fraction acts by the same inverse-uniformizer scalar on both sides. Thus the comparison holds on the whole raw category, not merely its heart. No nonempty or positive-rank hypothesis is used.
